_comment: Every axiom in the minted modules is here: `pinned` names the reasoner case that proves it does something, `exempt` says why it has none. scripts/check_axioms.py fails on an axiom in neither, on an entry naming an axiom that no longer exists, and on a `pinned` claim that does not hold when the axiom is deleted. Regenerate the pinned set with `poetry run python3 scripts/check_axioms.py --discover`; the reasons are hand-written and --discover never overwrites them.
